data_fields.name: steep_slope_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: acos(1 - 0.41221) - 0.02 (about 0.92 rad, worked out by hand, not run)

best_idea: Place hubs one at a time: each new hub must stay outside the claim cylinder of every hub already placed, is scored against the free anchors that remain, and then stands a fixed offset from the best anchor toward its nearest neighbour.
decision_why: Keep the claim-then-place order and the claim cylinder (radius and height) as the spacing rule for town or service hubs; drop the equal-value metal score and the walkable branch until the fixes are in; replace metal spots with landmark or resource anchors from zone data.
acceptance: On a generated zone, no second hub is placed inside the first hub's claim cylinder; a server test places four hubs in a fixed order and asserts the same layout on every run.
